introduction.zh: 不考剧情，不按外貌或性别分类。26道普通选择，借13位动画角色比较不同的自选做法；角色集合来自官方目录，题目与读法由费马独立创作。全部最高并列完整呈现。
introduction.en: No episode trivia or classification by appearance or gender. Twenty-six ordinary questions use thirteen animated characters to compare chosen approaches. The roster has an official source; items and readings are independently authored. Every highest tie appears in full.

instructions.zh: 本版26题原创非官方同人问卷，选用当前迪士尼公主官方目录的13位虚构角色，比较你在普通小事里目前愿意采用的做法。角色集合有官方出处，题目、映射和解释由费马独立创作，并非迪士尼官方测验。每题从四种做法选一个较接近自己的，均以自选、许可、可改与可停止为前提。每选加1，每位全卷出现8次，全部最高并列完整显示。结果不判断外貌、肤色、性别、族群、宗教、善良程度、勇气、天赋、婚恋或职业，不要求模仿忍受伤害、战斗、航海或魔法；宝嘉康蒂只指动画角色，不代表历史人物与原住民。无需剧情知识，也不换算MBTI。
instructions.en: This original 26-question unofficial fan quiz uses the 13 fictional characters in Disney’s current official Princess directory to compare ordinary approaches you currently prefer. The roster has an official source; items, mappings and interpretations are independently authored by FermatMind rather than an official Disney test. Choose the closer of four approaches in voluntary, permitted, revisable and stoppable situations. Each choice adds one, each character appears eight times and every highest tie receives its full guide. Results judge no appearance, skin colour, gender, ethnicity, religion, goodness, bravery, talent, romance or career and invite no imitation of accepting harm, combat, navigation or magic. Pocahontas means the animated character, not the historical person or Indigenous peoples. Episode knowledge is unnecessary and there is no MBTI conversion.

title.zh: 动画角色与本版读法
title.en: Animated character and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 这里的白雪公主指迪士尼动画中的虚构角色，属于当前官方公主目录。本站选取“给愿意加入的人留一点位置”的有限同人角度，不把人物故事里的遭遇、外貌或性别角色变成你的品质。欢迎也不意味着必须相信每个人、承担家务或忍受伤害；这些都不是题本所测内容或结果要求。
paragraphs.en: Snow White here means the fictional Disney animated character in the current official Princess directory. This edition selects room for willing participation as a limited fan reading rather than turning fictional experiences, appearance or gender roles into your qualities. Welcome requires neither trusting everyone, doing domestic work nor enduring harm; none is measured by these questions or required by a result in actual life.

paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose an easy opening, a welcoming place or participation without pulling people in. Who wants to join, what makes joining possible and is declining comfortable? Counts observe neither others’ welcome nor kindness, warmth, care skill or popularity. Fewer choices may simply concern an activity better done alone rather than coldness towards actual people in other circumstances.

title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，自愿布置一个普通小角落时，你提议留一张空卡，让愿意的人各写一个喜欢的颜色；也允许只看、不写或完全不加入。空卡本身不等于所有人都同意公开名字或作品，是否保存和分享仍需再问。这个例子给参与留位置，而不是用人多、气氛好或得到感谢来证明自己善良。
paragraphs.en: Arranging a small corner together, leave a blank card for willing participants to name a colour they like. Looking silently, not writing and not joining remain possible. A blank card implies no agreement to publish names or work; ask separately about keeping or sharing it. The example leaves an opening rather than proving goodness through attendance, atmosphere or receiving gratitude from someone who participated.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“这里留了一个位置，你愿意可以加入，不参加也没有关系。”如果对方拒绝，不需要再用热情劝说；自己不愿接待时，也可以说清这次范围。欢迎与边界可以同在，不必因为白雪公主这个名字而始终微笑、招待或照顾别人；现实中的每位参与者都保留自己的选择。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “There is room here if you want to join; declining is fine.” Refusal needs no further enthusiastic persuasion, and you can state limits when you do not want to host. Welcome and boundaries can coexist. The name Snow White demands no constant smiling, hospitality or care, while every actual participant retains their own choices in the particular activity and circumstances.

title.en: Comparisons with the other twelve character readings

paragraphs.zh: 与灰姑娘的小盼望、爱洛的安静想象、爱丽儿的陌生好奇不同，这一角度先看参与入口；贝儿偏读懂、茉莉偏自选表达、宝嘉康蒂偏周围联系、花木兰偏实际回应。蒂安娜偏一步安排、乐佩偏表达形式、梅莉达偏自选做法、莫阿娜偏路径连接、拉雅偏具体约定。它们可以一起出现，没有谁更美、善良或值得被爱。
paragraphs.en: Unlike Cinderella’s small hopes, Aurora’s quiet imagination and Ariel’s unfamiliar curiosity, this angle first concerns an opening to join. Belle concerns understanding, Jasmine personal choices, Pocahontas local connections and Mulan actual needs. Tiana concerns a step, Rapunzel expressive forms, Merida chosen approaches, Moana connected routes and Raya agreements. These may coexist without ranking beauty, goodness or deserving love, or assigning a superior real personality to anyone.

Counts measure no gullibility, victimisation risk, dependence, trauma, mental health or actual relationship. Fictional danger is not explained through someone being too kind. Understand actual harm through specific actions and responsibility rather than using appearance, gentleness or a quiz label to minimise it or blame a person who was harmed.

paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose to keep a small hope, leave room for a preference or remember an ordinary place you want to see. Fewer choices may mean no relevant wish rather than pessimism, coldness or lack of belief in an actual future.

paragraphs.en: Leave a page in a personal collection saying you might like to find a particular blue sometime. You may enjoy that possibility without buying or searching. Revise or remove it if circumstances or interests change. This separates a wish from a required task, and obtaining the object tests neither persistence, deservingness nor destiny in the actual course of an ordinary personal activity.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达

No one must fulfil it, and the character demands no ongoing belief, sacrifice or waiting. Discuss actual conditions, rights and feasible arrangements directly instead of preserving a fictional image of yourself for others.

title.zh: 动画角色与本版读法
title.en: Animated character and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.en: Aurora here means the fictional character from Disney’s animated Sleeping Beauty. This fan reading selects imagining an ordinary scene first rather than translating sleep, curses or rescue into actual advice. Quiet imagination may be a chosen interest without implying passivity, indecision, waiting for a partner or compulsory gentleness, and it evaluates neither sleep nor health in the actual life of a respondent.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose an imagined scene, room for an idea that need not be realised or no immediate finished output. Which scene appeals, and do you only want to imagine or to do more? Counts observe no vividness, creativity, concentration or action skill. Fewer choices may reflect interest in actual objects rather than deficient imagination, excessive practicality or absent romance.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，一件可以随时改回的小摆设让你想象窗边有一张蓝色小卡，可以只在脑中放着，也可以画个草图。没有材料、不打算动手或后来想改，都不让这段想象变成失败。若需要和别人商量实际摆放，另行谈空间、许可与时间，不能把自己想过的画面当成共同已经同意的安排。
paragraphs.en: A reversible personal arrangement suggests an imagined blue card by a window. Keep the scene in mind or sketch it. Missing materials, no intention to act or a later change do not make the imagining a failure. Discuss actual space, permission and timing separately with others rather than treating a scene you pictured as an arrangement everyone has already agreed to implement in real life.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我先在脑中想一想，还没有决定要做；这个画面也可以变。”对方不需要猜懂或替你实现，你也可以决定不解释。安静与表达不互斥，想象和实际承诺要分清；爱洛的名字不要求你一直柔和、沉默或等事情发生，也不把主动选择说成“不像这个角色”。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I’m imagining it first and haven’t decided to do it; the scene can change.” Others need neither guess nor realise it for you, and you may keep it private. Quiet and expression can coexist while imagination remains distinct from commitment. Aurora’s name requires no perpetual softness, silence or waiting and makes no active choice a failure to resemble the character.

title.en: Comparisons with the other twelve character readings

paragraphs.en: Aurora concerns imagined scenes, Cinderella small hopes, Ariel unfamiliar curiosity and Rapunzel expressive forms; imagination need not include a wish or output. Snow White concerns participation, Belle understanding, Jasmine choices, Pocahontas surroundings, Mulan actual needs, Tiana a step, Merida chosen approaches, Moana connected routes and Raya agreements. These are offered angles without higher, lower or more romantic personalities, or an obligatory sequence for someone’s actual life.

paragraphs.en: Imagining first may follow waiting for materials, needing quiet or missing information rather than a lasting preference. The quiz measures no daydreaming, dissociation, sleep, procrastination, attachment or psychological causes and gives no treatment or relationship advice from a fictional plot. Actual unwillingness, constraints or danger need specific understanding, rather than invoking character-like waiting to disregard a person’s wishes or rights in real circumstances.

title.zh: 可选的小观察
title.en: An optional observation

paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, imagine an ordinary arrangement for a small object you already like. Drawing, action and sharing are unnecessary; skip it if preferred. Notice the appeal without scoring vividness, feasibility or popularity. Imagining creates no promise, and stopping loses no dream. The quiz requires neither turning every mental picture into a task nor completing it to prove anything about your actual worth or abilities.

description.en: Explore Ariel through an unfamiliar booklet topic, curiosity and permission. Full comparisons without risk, bravery, singing or relationship claims.

title.zh: 动画角色与本版读法
title.en: Animated character and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 爱丽儿在这里指迪士尼动画中的人鱼角色，本站只选“想了解熟悉范围外的一点东西”的同人角度。对未知好奇不等于要签危险约定、放弃表达、离家冒险或为关系牺牲；剧情里的魔法、歌声与转变不成为你的能力或人生安排。本版普通题目也不评估海上活动。
paragraphs.en: Ariel here means Disney’s animated mermaid character. This edition selects interest in something beyond the familiar rather than dangerous agreements, surrendering expression, leaving home or sacrificing for a relationship. Fictional magic, song and transformation establish no actual ability or life arrangement for you. These ordinary questions evaluate no activity at sea or skill involved in carrying one out safely in real conditions.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择看看陌生题目、了解没留意过的小材料，或给普通新发现留一点空间。可以问：具体对哪里好奇，眼前信息是否足够，能否只了解而不行动？次数不观察知识增长、勇气、独立或探索效果；少选可能因为更想深入熟悉东西，不表示封闭或没有好奇心。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose an unfamiliar topic or material or room for an ordinary discovery. Which detail interests you, is information sufficient and can learning remain without action? Counts observe neither knowledge gained, bravery, independence nor exploration outcomes. Fewer choices may reflect wanting depth in something familiar rather than being closed or lacking curiosity in other actual situations and interests.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，和朋友看一本普通小册子时，你想先翻一页自己没注意过的题目。可以只读一句、问一个词，再决定要不要继续；不懂或不喜欢都可以停。好奇针对一小处，不需要把整本读完、买相关东西或接受所有说法；涉及别人作品和物品时，仍需按许可使用，不把探索当作随意翻动的权利。
paragraphs.en: Looking at an ordinary booklet with a friend, turn to an unfamiliar topic and read a sentence or ask about a word before deciding whether to continue. Stop if uninterested or unclear. Curiosity need not finish a book, require a purchase or accept every claim, and others’ work and belongings still require permission rather than exploration providing a right to handle them freely in actual life.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我对这一小处有点好奇，想先了解，不代表已经决定照做。”如果别人不愿解释，可以查公开允许的资料或先放下，不追问隐私。自己也可以保留未知、改变兴趣或选择熟悉的方式；结果像爱丽儿，不要求你永远向外探索、接受风险或证明自己比别人更勇敢。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I’m curious about this small detail and want to understand it, without deciding to act.” If someone does not want to explain, use permitted public material or leave it rather than pursuing privacy. Keep uncertainty, change interests or choose familiarity whenever preferred. An Ariel-like result requires neither constant exploration, accepting risk nor proving greater courage than someone else in actual life.

title.zh: 与其他十二位角色比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other twelve character readings

paragraphs.zh: 爱丽儿偏接触陌生，贝儿偏读懂意思、乐佩偏表达形式、莫阿娜偏路径与在意之处；陌生不一定要去远方。白雪公主参与入口、灰姑娘小盼望、爱洛场景想象、茉莉自选表达、宝嘉康蒂周围联系、花木兰实际回应、蒂安娜一步安排、梅莉达自选做法、拉雅具体约定，都是相邻可用角度，不是冒险能力或自由程度排名。
paragraphs.en: Ariel concerns unfamiliar things, Belle understanding meaning, Rapunzel expressive forms and Moana connected routes; unfamiliarity need not require travel. Snow White concerns participation, Cinderella hopes, Aurora imagination, Jasmine choices, Pocahontas surroundings, Mulan actual needs, Tiana a step, Merida chosen approaches and Raya agreements. These are neighbouring angles that may coexist rather than ranks of risk skill, freedom or suitability for a particular actual lifestyle or relationship.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的现实情况
title.en: Counterexamples and actual circumstances not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，选新东西可能因为熟悉物品不可用，不是持续偏好；重复熟悉活动同样可能有新发现。问卷不判断冲动、风险承受、歌唱能力、身体变化、年龄或恋爱模式，也不把剧情牺牲当成现实真爱证明。重大约定与现实危险需要具体信息、同意和判断，不能由角色名字替代。
paragraphs.en: Choosing something new may follow an unavailable familiar option rather than preference, while repetition can offer discovery. The quiz establishes no impulsiveness, risk tolerance, singing ability, bodily change, age or romantic pattern, and fictional sacrifice proves no actual love. Major agreements and real danger require specific information, consent and judgement rather than replacement by a character name or voluntary counts from ordinary questions in this fan quiz.

title.zh: 可选的小观察
title.en: An optional observation

paragraphs.zh: 可选观察：为一件本来想了解的普通小事，记一个陌生细节和一个仍不知道的问题，可以不搜索、不行动或不分享。留意是否喜欢接触这个新东西，不给大胆、独立或学习能力评分；也可以马上结束。不必把好奇变成必须跨越边界的挑战，更不需要用风险来证明自己像爱丽儿。
paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, note an unfamiliar detail and an unanswered question about something ordinary you already want to understand. Search, action and sharing are optional, and you may stop. Notice interest without grading boldness, independence or learning ability. Curiosity need become neither a compulsory challenge to cross boundaries nor a risk taken to prove that you sufficiently resemble Ariel in your actual life.

title.zh: 动画角色与本版读法
title.en: Animated character and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 贝儿在迪士尼动画设定中喜欢阅读。本版借“读一段、问清它具体是什么意思”作有限同人角度，不把阅读爱好等同聪明、善良或高人一等。人物的城堡与关系故事不提供现实亲密关系规则，更不要求你忽略危险、改变别人或用忍耐去发现一个人所谓内在的好。
paragraphs.en: Belle’s animated context includes an interest in reading. This edition selects reading a passage and asking what it means rather than equating books with intelligence, goodness or superiority. Fictional castle and relationship stories provide no rules for actual intimacy and require neither overlooking danger, changing another person nor enduring harm to discover an allegedly good interior in someone who acts harmfully in real life.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择读懂不清楚的话、了解来历或区分知道与猜测。可以问：现在想弄懂哪一点，依据在哪里，哪些仍然不知道？次数不检验知识、理解准确性、语言能力、同理心或道德。少选可能因为已经了解、不想阅读或需要另一种形式，不说明笨、肤浅或缺少独立思考。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose an unclear statement, its origins or a distinction between knowledge and guesses. Which detail matters, where is support and what remains unknown? Counts test no knowledge, accuracy, language skill, empathy or morality. Fewer choices may follow existing understanding, no interest in reading or a preference for another format rather than stupidity, shallowness or absent independent thought in actual life.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，一份普通说明写“这种纸适合所有用途”，你想先问它说的是哪些用途、有没有实际范围。可以把不确定处留下，另读允许查阅的资料，不需要马上反驳或证明自己更懂。阅读针对具体信息，不是评价作者整个人；若要拿它作实际用途，仍要核对相应条件，而不是仅凭喜欢阅读就认为已验证。
paragraphs.en: An ordinary description says a paper suits every use. Ask which uses and what limits apply. Leave uncertainty or read permitted material without immediately arguing or proving greater knowledge. Reading concerns specific information rather than judging the whole author. An actual use still needs its own conditions checked; enjoying reading is not itself verification that an object, claim or method is suitable for that real purpose.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我想先弄清这句话的意思和依据，暂时还有一处不知道。”别人可以不继续讨论，也不用接受你的全部理解；自己同样可以改变想法。询问不代表有权审问隐私，文字清楚也不自动等于判断正确。贝儿的名字不要求你随时读书、解释、教育别人，或为了显得善解人意而承担关系修复。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I want to understand this statement and its support; one detail remains uncertain.” Others may decline discussion or disagree with your interpretation, and you may revise it. Questions grant no right to private information, and clear words do not ensure correct judgement. Belle’s name requires neither constant reading, explaining and teaching nor relationship repair performed to appear understanding towards someone else.

title.zh: 与其他十二位角色比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other twelve character readings

paragraphs.zh: 贝儿偏读懂意思，爱丽儿偏接触陌生；阅读也可以面对熟悉事物。白雪公主参与、灰姑娘盼望、爱洛想象、茉莉选择、宝嘉康蒂联系、花木兰回应、蒂安娜一步、乐佩形式、梅莉达自选、莫阿娜路径、拉雅约定，各有独立角度。它们不是智力、学历、职业或善良的十三等级。
paragraphs.en: Belle concerns understanding meaning, while Ariel concerns unfamiliar things; reading may address something familiar. Snow White concerns participation, Cinderella hopes, Aurora imagination, Jasmine choices, Pocahontas surroundings, Mulan actual needs, Tiana a step, Rapunzel expressive forms, Merida chosen approaches, Moana connected routes and Raya agreements. These are separate angles rather than thirteen levels of intelligence, education, career suitability or actual goodness.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的现实情况
title.en: Counterexamples and actual circumstances not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，多读一点可能因为说明太模糊，不是固定偏好；听懂、看懂或直接试一小处也可以有充分思考。本版不测智力、共情、依恋、审美、创伤或关系安全，也不能用“看内在”要求容忍危险。现实中的伤害与同意需要按具体事实理解，不由童话结局或角色标签作结论。
paragraphs.en: Extra reading may follow a vague description rather than a fixed preference, while listening, observing or trying a little can be thoughtful too. The quiz measures no intelligence, empathy, attachment, aesthetics, trauma or relationship safety. Looking beyond appearances cannot require tolerating danger. Actual harm and agreement need specific facts rather than conclusions drawn from a fairytale ending or an entertaining character label from this questionnaire.

title.zh: 可选的小观察
title.en: An optional observation

paragraphs.zh: 可选观察：从自己本来想读的一小段里，记一个已经理解的意思和一个仍然不确定的问题，不必补查、分享或写成长文。看看这种追问是否符合当前兴趣，不按读得快、知道多或说服别人来评分。也可以不做；测试不要求证明“像贝儿所以聪明”，更不把阅读变成人格价值。
paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, note one understood point and one uncertainty in a passage you already want to read. Further research, sharing and a long written response are unnecessary. Notice interest without scoring speed, knowledge or persuasion, and skip it if preferred. The quiz requires no proof of intelligence through a Belle-like match and makes no reading habit a measure of your actual worth as a person.

description.en: Explore Jasmine through personal choices and a shared arrangement. Full examples without gender, culture, defiance, romance or leadership judgements.

title.zh: 动画角色与本版读法
title.en: Animated character and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 茉莉在这里指迪士尼动画《阿拉丁》中的虚构角色。本版借“把自己愿意的选择说清”作有限同人读法，不把宫廷、文化或浪漫故事当成答题者的真实身份和经历。任何性别都可以有个人意愿；表达选择不要求对抗、冒险或为证明独立而拒绝所有帮助，也不替现实约定作决定。
paragraphs.en: Jasmine here means the fictional character in Disney’s animated Aladdin. This limited fan reading concerns expressing a choice you want rather than assigning palace, cultural or romantic experiences to respondents. Personal wishes belong to people of any gender. Expression requires neither confrontation, risk nor refusing every offer of help to prove independence, and supplies no decision on actual agreements or circumstances faced by someone in real life.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，本次较常选择说明喜欢的做法、不愿答应的部分，或不想被别人代替决定的小事情。可以问：具体选什么，哪些还未决定，什么条件需要共同讨论？次数不判断自信、胆量、正义或表达效果，少选也可能因为这件事没有强烈偏好，不表示软弱、顺从或没有自己的想法。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose to state a preference, an unaccepted commitment or a matter you do not want decided for you. What is chosen, what remains undecided and which conditions need discussion? Counts establish no confidence, courage, justice or expressive effectiveness. Fewer choices may reflect no strong preference rather than weakness, compliance or absent personal views about an actual matter or wider life.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，朋友提出一套习惯的兴趣活动流程，你说自己想参加展示部分，但暂时不愿意被拍照或接下主持。也可以改变主意，并重新谈实际影响。把意愿说清，是让安排有机会获得真正同意，不等于别人必须照你希望的方式组织，也不以最终是否被接受来判断表达有没有价值。
paragraphs.en: A friend proposes a customary hobby sequence. You want to join the display but not photographs or hosting. You may revise that and discuss actual effects. Stating wishes gives arrangements an opportunity for real agreement without requiring others to organise exactly as you prefer, or judging the value of expression solely by whether a request is accepted in the eventual ordinary shared activity.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“这一部分我愿意，另一部分还没有答应，希望先由我自己决定。”别人也保留不合作或提出限制的权利，你可以听清而不把不同意见当成否定整个人。角色名不能让已承诺的具体事情自动失效；需要改变就谈清范围，不必用强硬、甜美或永远勇敢的表演来符合茉莉形象。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I want this part, and have not agreed to the other; I’d like to decide it myself first.” Others retain the option to decline cooperation or state limits. Hear differences without treating them as rejection of your whole self. A name cancels no actual commitment automatically; discuss changes without performing toughness, sweetness or constant bravery to fit an image of Jasmine.

title.zh: 与其他十二位角色比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other twelve character readings

paragraphs.zh: 茉莉偏把选择说清，梅莉达偏采用自己选的做法，拉雅偏合作中的具体约定，三者可以同时出现。白雪公主参与、灰姑娘盼望、爱洛想象、爱丽儿好奇、贝儿读懂、宝嘉康蒂联系、花木兰回应、蒂安娜一步、乐佩形式、莫阿娜路径，分别比较选项，不是自信、女权、文化或爱情的等级。
paragraphs.en: Jasmine concerns expressing choices, Merida a chosen approach and Raya concrete cooperation agreements; these can coexist. Snow White concerns participation, Cinderella hopes, Aurora imagination, Ariel curiosity, Belle understanding, Pocahontas surroundings, Mulan actual needs, Tiana a step, Rapunzel expressive forms and Moana connected routes. These compare offered approaches rather than levels of confidence, feminism, cultural identity, romance or the actual worth of a person’s choices.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的现实情况
title.en: Counterexamples and actual circumstances not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 若次数最高，本次较常选择用线条、颜色、短句、排列等形式表达，而不是只保留一种说法。可以问：想表达的具体是什么，现在愿意试哪一种形式，是否只留给自己？次数不观察作品质量、创造力、情绪或技术，少选可能因为更想理解或直接处理事情，不说明没想法、乏味或不能表达。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose lines, colours, short wording or arrangement rather than one fixed format. What meaning matters, which form interests you and may it remain private? Counts observe no output quality, creativity, mood or technique. Fewer choices may reflect wanting understanding or direct handling rather than absent ideas, dullness or an inability to express yourself in other actual settings and forms.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，给私人笔记添一页，你想用一条线、一个色块和一句自编短话表示同一个普通感受。可以只做其中一种，也可以写到一半结束，不需要公开、获得赞美或做成作品集。形式的变化服务你现在的意思，不是必须创新、证明审美或把个人生活持续变成内容。
paragraphs.en: Adding a page to personal notes, you try one line, colour block or sentence of your own for an ordinary impression. Use only one or stop halfway without publishing, earning praise or assembling a portfolio. A changed form serves your current meaning rather than an obligation to innovate, prove taste or continually turn actual personal life into content for an audience of other people.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我想换一种形式表达这一小处，暂时不需要评价，也可以不分享。”别人不必理解成你唯一真实的心声，自己也可以随后改写。若用到他人作品、照片或文字，需要相应许可；灵感不等于授权。乐佩的名字不要求你一直乐观、热情或富有创意，也不把沉默与不创作当失败。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I want another form for this small detail without feedback or sharing for now.” Others need not treat it as your sole true voice, and you may revise it. Others’ work, photographs and words require appropriate permission; inspiration is no licence. Rapunzel’s name demands neither constant optimism, enthusiasm nor creativity and treats silence or not creating as no failure in an actual person’s life.

title.zh: 与其他十二位角色比较

paragraphs.zh: 乐佩偏表达形式，爱洛偏场景想象、爱丽儿偏陌生好奇、贝儿偏读懂意思；有表达不一定先有完整画面。白雪公主参与、灰姑娘盼望、茉莉选择、宝嘉康蒂联系、花木兰回应、蒂安娜一步、梅莉达自选、莫阿娜路径、拉雅约定，各比较另一类做法。这不是艺术、想象力、性别魅力或成长程度的排序。

description.zh: 用一次自选短途出门看路径、目的与在意之处，含十二角色比较；不测航海、文化认同、使命、勇气或领导力。
description.en: Explore Moana through a short outing’s route and what matters. Full comparisons without navigation, cultural identity, destiny or leadership certification.

title.zh: 动画角色与本版读法
title.en: Animated character and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 莫阿娜在这里指迪士尼动画角色，不把电影中的航行、海洋回应或文化设定变成答题者的技能、血缘或使命。本站只借“把眼前路径与自己在意的人、地方或事情连起来”的有限同人角度，不代表波利尼西亚人民的性格，也不要求重演出海冒险或承担拯救社区的任务。
paragraphs.en: Moana here means Disney’s animated character rather than turning fictional voyages, the ocean’s response or cultural setting into a respondent’s skill, ancestry or calling. This limited fan reading connects an ordinary route with people, places or matters you care about. It represents no Polynesian personality and requires neither reenacting a voyage nor carrying a mission to save a community in an actual person’s life.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，本次较常选择看看一小段路径与自己在意的目的或共同事情怎样相连。可以问：为什么想走这一步，和谁有关，哪些实际条件需要另查？次数不观察方向感、航海、领导、责任或任务完成，少选可能只是这次不需要想路径，不表示没有归属、目标或关心别人的能力。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose to connect a small route with a purpose or shared matter. Why take this step, who is involved and which actual conditions need checking separately? Counts observe neither direction sense, navigation, leadership, responsibility nor completion. Fewer choices may mean no route question this time rather than absent belonging, aims or care for other people in actual situations.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，准备一次自己想去的普通短途出门，你发现最想去的是朋友曾提过的一处公开小展示，可以把这个目的和允许使用的实际路线分开核对。路线不适合或对方没空时，可以改期、独自去或不去；在意某件事不等于必须完成旅程，更不等于已经具备出行或导航所需信息。
paragraphs.en: Planning a short outing you want, you notice an interest in a public display a friend mentioned. Keep that purpose distinct from checking an actual permitted route. Reschedule, go alone or stop if the route is unsuitable or the person unavailable. Caring about a matter requires no completed journey and supplies no information or skill needed for actual travel or navigation in real conditions.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我想走这一小段，因为它和我在意的事情有关；实际怎么走、别人愿不愿意还要另确认。”对方没有义务同行或把同一个地方当归属，自己也可以改变目的。莫阿娜的名字不授权替社区、家庭或文化发言，也不要求永远勇敢、独立或承担所有人的期待。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I want this small route because it connects with something I care about; practical arrangements and others’ willingness still need checking.” No one must accompany you or share your belonging, and your purpose may change. Moana’s name permits no speaking for a community, family or culture and requires neither perpetual bravery, independence nor carrying everyone’s expectations in actual life.

title.zh: 与其他十二位角色比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other twelve character readings

paragraphs.zh: 莫阿娜偏路径与在意之处，爱丽儿偏陌生好奇、宝嘉康蒂偏周围联系、蒂安娜偏一步安排；路径不一定要去远方。白雪公主参与、灰姑娘盼望、爱洛想象、贝儿读懂、茉莉选择、花木兰回应、乐佩形式、梅莉达自选、拉雅约定，各给另一角度。它们不是探索能力、族群认同、使命或领导等级。
paragraphs.en: Moana concerns connected routes, Ariel unfamiliar curiosity, Pocahontas surroundings and Tiana a step; a route need not involve distance. Snow White concerns participation, Cinderella hopes, Aurora imagination, Belle understanding, Jasmine choices, Mulan actual needs, Rapunzel expressive forms, Merida chosen approaches and Raya agreements. These are other offered angles rather than levels of exploration skill, ethnic identity, calling or actual leadership for someone navigating ordinary life.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的现实情况
title.en: Counterexamples and actual circumstances not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，想清路径可能仅因为交通或无障碍条件要求，不是持续偏好；没有出门也可以很在意家人、朋友和社区。问卷不测文化、宗教、导航、危险承受、身体能力或人生方向，更不把海洋与祖先联系写成现实超自然认证。真实出行与安全需要具体信息，不能凭角色结果忽略限制或冒险。
paragraphs.en: Thinking about a route may follow transport or accessibility needs rather than preference, and staying home can coexist with care for family, friends and community. The quiz measures no culture, religion, navigation, risk tolerance, bodily ability or life direction and certifies no supernatural ocean or ancestral connection. Actual travel and safety need specific information rather than a character result excusing ignored limits or risk-taking in real conditions.

title.zh: 可选的小观察
title.en: An optional observation

paragraphs.zh: 可选观察：为一件本来就想做的低风险小事，写一句它和自己在意之处的联系，再写一项实际仍不知道的条件，不必出门、行动或分享。留意这样的连接是否符合当前想法，不给使命、勇气或社区贡献评分；也可以略过。决定不走这一步，不表示失去归属或辜负角色。
paragraphs.en: For an optional observation, note how something low-stakes you already want connects with what matters, plus one actual unknown condition. Travel, action and sharing are unnecessary. Notice whether the connection fits without scoring calling, bravery or contribution, and skip it if preferred. Declining this step neither loses belonging nor disappoints a character; it remains an actual choice you may make in your own circumstances.

Each appears eight times and twice in each position; the nine absent options are not rejections. Every highest count keeps its full guide. Choosing the first option throughout gives two each and all thirteen guides. List order establishes no priority or automatic second character. title.zh: 动画角色与本版读法
title.en: Animated character and this edition’s reading

paragraphs.zh: 拉雅在这里指迪士尼动画《寻龙传说》的虚构角色。本站只选“借具体信息和约定确认愿意怎样合作”的有限同人角度，不把电影中的背叛、龙与战斗变成现实经历或方法。合作不等于盲目信任、必须宽恕或重新靠近伤害者，角色也不代表东南亚任何人民、文化或宗教的统一性格。
paragraphs.en: Raya here means the fictional character in Disney’s animated Raya and the Last Dragon. This limited fan reading uses specific information and agreements to confirm willing cooperation rather than assigning betrayal, dragons or combat as actual experiences or methods. Cooperation requires neither blind trust, forgiveness nor renewed closeness to someone harmful, and the character represents no unified personality of Southeast Asian peoples, cultures or religions.

title.zh: 计数对应哪些当前选择
title.en: Which current choices the count describes

paragraphs.zh: 若计数最高，本次较常选择谈清双方真正同意的小范围、还不知道的信息，或变化后需要重新谈的部分。可以问：具体答应什么，怎样知道对方愿意，哪些没有承诺？次数不观察是否值得信任、能否建立信任、合作效果或关系安全，少选也可能因为眼前事情不需要协作，不说明猜疑、冷淡或不愿相信别人。
paragraphs.en: A highest count means you more often chose a small agreed scope, missing information or terms needing discussion after changes. What is promised, how is willingness known and what remains uncommitted? Counts observe neither trustworthiness, ability to trust, cooperation outcomes nor relationship safety. Fewer choices may follow no collaboration need rather than suspicion, coldness or unwillingness to believe other people in an actual relationship or situation.

title.zh: 一个具体普通例子
title.en: A concrete ordinary example

paragraphs.zh: 例如，共同整理几张自愿提供的小卡，可以先确认谁愿意拿出哪张、能否改字、是否保存，以及不想继续时怎样取回。对方不同意某项，就不把这项算进去；约定不是保证永远顺利，而是眼前可核的范围。它不要求透露隐私、交出物品或用牺牲证明相信，也不把一次合作成功当作关系安全的认证。
paragraphs.en: Sorting voluntarily supplied cards, confirm which each person offers, whether wording may change, whether cards are kept and how to withdraw. Exclude unagreed terms. An agreement is an immediate checkable scope rather than guaranteed harmony; it requires neither private disclosure, handing over possessions nor sacrifice to prove belief. A successful small collaboration certifies no safety of an actual relationship beyond that specific ordinary arrangement.

title.zh: 一句可用的表达
title.en: A possible way to express the preference

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“这一小段我愿意，另一部分需要再了解；你也可以不同意或退出。”如果约定改变，重新确认，不把沉默当同意。自己可以暂不合作或结束，别人也不必因为你想建立信任就配合；拉雅的名字不要求你放下警惕、展示宽恕或承担修复每段关系的责任。
paragraphs.en: You might say, “I want this small part and need more information about the other; you may disagree or leave too.” Confirm changed terms without treating silence as consent. You may decline cooperation, and others need not participate because you want trust. Raya’s name demands neither lowered caution, displayed forgiveness nor responsibility for repairing every actual relationship or disagreement in a respondent’s own life.

title.zh: 与其他十二位角色比较
title.en: Comparisons with the other twelve character readings

paragraphs.zh: 拉雅偏具体合作约定，茉莉偏把选择说清、梅莉达偏自选做法、花木兰偏实际变化、蒂安娜偏一步安排；约定可以先于信任感。白雪公主参与、灰姑娘盼望、爱洛想象、爱丽儿好奇、贝儿读懂、宝嘉康蒂联系、乐佩形式、莫阿娜路径，各给另一角度。它们不是信任、宽恕、成熟、文化或合作能力的十三等级。
paragraphs.en: Raya concerns agreements, Jasmine expressing choices, Merida chosen approaches, Mulan actual changes and Tiana a step; agreement may precede a feeling of trust. Snow White concerns participation, Cinderella hopes, Aurora imagination, Ariel curiosity, Belle understanding, Pocahontas surroundings, Rapunzel expressive forms and Moana connected routes. These offer other angles rather than thirteen ranks of trust, forgiveness, maturity, cultural identity or actual ability to cooperate with other people.

title.zh: 反例与不能推断的现实情况
title.en: Counterexamples and actual circumstances not inferred

paragraphs.zh: 反例是，多核一条约定可能因为资料归属要求，不是稳定偏好；已经说清的事情也可能不用反复确认。问卷不测创伤、猜疑、依恋、危险性、领导或心理健康，不把剧情转折当现实宽恕建议。真实关系与安全需要具体行为、权利和相应信息，不能用“学拉雅相信”要求别人重返伤害或交出边界。
paragraphs.en: Checking another term may follow ownership requirements rather than preference, and clear matters need no endless reconfirmation. The quiz measures no trauma, suspicion, attachment, danger, leadership or mental health and makes no fictional turn advice to forgive. Actual relationships and safety require specific conduct, rights and information rather than demands to trust like Raya, return to harm or surrender boundaries because of a voluntary character interpretation.

title.zh: 可选的小观察
title.en: An optional observation

paragraphs.zh: 可选观察：为一件本来愿意合作的低风险小事，写一项已同意、一项未同意和一项仍需询问的内容，可以不发给别人。留意是否喜欢把范围说清，不按信任感、对方是否满意或结果成功评分；也可以略过。选择不合作仍然完整，不需要证明自己已经被治愈、学会原谅或配得上角色。

Notice whether explicit scope appeals without scoring trust, satisfaction or success, and skip it if preferred. Declining cooperation remains complete and requires no proof of healing, forgiveness or deserving a fictional character’s name in your own actual circumstances.

paragraphs.zh: 26题全部各选一项，对应的本版角色读法加1，总数固定26。每题只提供十三位中的四位，全卷每位8次、每位置2次；当题未提供的九位不记拒绝。所有最高计数逐份保留完整说明，全选第一项会十三位各2次，十三份完整显示。顺序不设主次，不自动指定第二角色；原始次数不是相似度、真实人格比例、成为公主的概率或优良品质分数。相差一次只是一项选择，不证明显著差异或固定类型。近分可自行比较，不补造并列、隐藏人格、混合身份或人群排名；条件和理解可以改变选择，本版没有常模、稀有度、科学分界或心理测量验证。
paragraphs.en: Choose one option for all 26 items; each adds one to its editorial character reading and counts sum to 26. Four of thirteen characters are offered per item. Each appears eight times and twice in each position; the nine absent options are not rejections. Every highest count keeps its full guide. Choosing the first option throughout gives two each and all thirteen guides. List order establishes no priority or automatic second character. Counts are neither similarity, actual personality proportions, probabilities of being a princess nor scores of good qualities. One extra choice proves no significance or fixed type. Read close guides without inventing ties, hidden traits, mixed identities or population ranks. Conditions and understanding can change choices; this edition has no norms, rarity estimates, scientific cutoffs or psychometric validation.

title.zh: 完整说明、并列与相近选择
title.en: Full guides, ties and close choices

paragraphs.zh: 13份完整说明各含动画背景、本版读法、普通例子、表达、十二角色比较、反例、小观察、计分和来源。所有最高并列逐份显示，不把名单第一位当主型，近分也不自动变第二身份。公开说明不显示任何人的私有答卷或计数。
paragraphs.en: Each of thirteen guides includes animated context, the editorial reading, an example, wording, twelve-character comparisons, counterexamples, an observation, scoring and sources. Every highest tie appears in full without treating the first as primary or making a close count a second identity. Public guides reveal no private attempt or counts.

title.zh: 为什么本版有13位？为什么不是剧情知识？
title.en: Why thirteen characters, and why no episode trivia?

paragraphs.zh: 本版按当前迪士尼公主官方目录列出的13位选择动画角色，不因此成为官方测验，也不把乐园“公主及女王”的艾莎、安娜合并成同一目录。题目是普通小事里的当前选择，基础背景可帮助理解，无需看全片。宝嘉康蒂的动画故事也不等于真实历史。
paragraphs.en: This edition selects the thirteen animated characters in the current official Disney Princess directory without becoming an official test or merging Elsa and Anna from a park’s broader Princesses and Queens collection into that roster. Ordinary current choices require no full-film knowledge. Pocahontas’s animated story is not actual history.

title.en: Unofficial fan interpretation and original content

The roster has an official source, but these items, mappings, counts and interpretations are no official Disney test and have no Disney or rights-holder partnership, authorisation or endorsement. Series and character rights belong to their respective owners. All 26 items, options, explanations, examples and rules are original. No IDR 35-item bank, competitor text or algorithm, dialogue, lyrics, subtitles, screenshots, character art, official activity bank or other protected material is used. Official pages check basic context without validating this psychology. Pocahontas means the animated character, not the historical Matoaka’s biography or an Indigenous personality; NPS and Pamunkey history only distinguish fiction and complex history without romanticising colonialism, captivity or coercion. title.zh: 草稿、分享与可选下一步
title.en: Drafts, sharing and optional next steps

paragraphs.zh: 答案在浏览器内计分，不上传、不进网址或分析。草稿需主动开启，只在本标签页恢复，24小时失效，完成、重测、退出清除即删除。可选分享只含公开角色说明和链接，不含答案或次数。完整结果免费，无需邮箱或先做另一测试；后续测评自选且另行作答。
paragraphs.en: Answers are scored in your browser without uploading them or placing them in URLs or analytics. Drafts require opt-in, restore only in this tab, expire after 24 hours and clear on completion, retake or exit-and-clear. Optional sharing contains public character guides and links without answers or counts. Full results are free without email or another test first; further assessments are optional and require new answers.

question.zh: 迪士尼公主测试包括哪13位？
question.en: Which thirteen Disney Princess characters are included?

answer.zh: 本版包括白雪公主、灰姑娘、爱洛、爱丽儿、贝儿、茉莉、宝嘉康蒂、花木兰、蒂安娜、乐佩、梅莉达、莫阿娜和拉雅。当前官方角色目录与本版同人解释是两件事；艾莎、安娜不在这个13位目录中，也不把角色名字当别名增加数量。
answer.en: This edition includes Snow White, Cinderella, Aurora, Ariel, Belle, Jasmine, Pocahontas, Mulan, Tiana, Rapunzel, Merida, Moana and Raya. The official roster and these fan interpretations are distinct. Elsa and Anna are not in this thirteen-character directory; alternate names do not add characters.

question.zh: 需要看过电影或按性别作答吗？
question.en: Must I watch films or answer by gender?

answer.zh: 不需要。26题是普通自选活动，没有剧情知识、外貌、性别、肤色或血缘输入，也不判断能力、道德与婚恋。基础动画背景只是有限读法，不把虚构当真实历史或人的完整经历。
answer.en: No. Twenty-six items concern ordinary chosen activities without trivia, appearance, gender, skin-colour or ancestry input or verdicts on ability, morality or romance. Basic animated context supports limited readings rather than actual history or a person’s whole life.
